en.lead: Confidence in the products, the company, and your own change.
en.intro: At Day 19 you have a solid understanding of nutrition. Today let's talk about confidence: in the products, in the company and, most importantly, in yourself.

points.p: According to 2024 data from international market research firm Euromonitor, Herbalife holds three global #1 positions:

img.cap: Three global #1s (source: Euromonitor, 2025 edition, 2024 retail sales data)

list: World's #1 weight management and wellness brand
World's #1 protein shake
World's #1 active lifestyle nutrition brand
points.after: Add the ingredients, the quality testing, and the real changes in you and the people around you — that's our confidence in the products.

points.p: Herbalife was founded in Los Angeles, USA in 1980, now operates in more than 90 countries and regions, and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
Herbalife products are certified by several international third-party bodies, including:
list: Low GI certification
NSF Certified for Sport: free of substances banned for athletes
Halal certification
Non-GMO verification
Vegetarian, gluten-free, USDA Organic and other certifications

points.p: From 2015 to 2024, Herbalife won 187 excellence awards in Asia Pacific, including:
list: Korea: Most Trusted Brand award for 13 consecutive years (health functional foods)
Taiwan: National Quality Mark for 13 consecutive years
Vietnam: Gold Product for Public Health award for 9 consecutive years
Thailand: Mahidol University Institute of Nutrition "Healthier Choice" logo for 7 consecutive years
Malaysia: Health & Wellness Brand Award 2019

img.cap: Asia Pacific product quality awards (Vietnam, Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong, Malaysia)

points.p: Herbalife nutrition products are also used in sport.
list: Sponsors more than 190 athletes, teams and sporting events
Athletes use it to help maintain energy during exercise

points.p: For over 40 years, focused on nutrition products and nutrition education, with formulas developed by nutrition and science teams.
With coach follow-up, a course and team support, you're not losing weight alone.
The most important confidence comes from you. Over these 19 days, you've already been changing your eating, drinking and exercise habits.

myth.m: Changing habits is too hard — I can't do it.
myth.f: You've kept going for 19 days. Every small change proves you can do it.

tips: Look back at your Day 1 records
Write down your progress and put it somewhere visible
Share your changes with your coach
en.task: Write down the most noticeable change in your body or habits over these 19 days and share it with your coach.
en.share: Do you know anyone who wants to change but lacks confidence in themselves?

ms.lead: Yakin dengan produk, syarikat, dan perubahan diri sendiri.
ms.intro: Sampai Hari 19, anda sudah mempunyai pengetahuan nutrisi yang kukuh. Hari ini kita bercakap tentang keyakinan: terhadap produk, syarikat, dan paling penting, diri anda sendiri.

list: Jenama pengurusan berat badan dan kesihatan No.1 dunia
Shake protein No.1 dunia
Jenama nutrisi gaya hidup aktif No.1 dunia
points.after: Ditambah dengan bahan, ujian kualiti, serta perubahan sebenar pada diri anda dan orang di sekeliling, itulah keyakinan kami terhadap produk.
